title: Author uploads, replaces, unpublishes and deletes HTML reports from the admin pages
how_to_read: Each attempt is one line and a `details` filename in this same directory. Open a detail file ONLY when this index points you at one -- the summaries are here so you do not have to. `caused_by` is what sent the stage back; `changed` is what the attempt then touched, counted by kind. Several attempts in a row that were caused by the same stage and changed no `src` is a loop, not progress.

open.issue: The admin page offers an upload form for one .html file with title, slug and a publish-now-or-draft choice (derived from 'From the admin page the author uploads ... gives it a title and slug, and publishes it now or saves it as a draft'): missing
The owner uploads a single self-contained .html file under a title and slug, and it is stored as a report (row plus file under the data dir): missing
Only one .html file is accepted. Other files and bad fields are refused and leave nothing behind (derived from 'a single self-contained .html file' and 'gives it a title and slug'): missing
Publish now sets the report published with a date; save as draft leaves it unpublished: missing

Replacing a report: uploading again under the same slug swaps the bytes and title and keeps the report's identity (id and original publish date), so later likes and comments stay attached (from merged SC-003): missing
Unpublish a report (and republish it, keeping the original date): missing
Delete a report: its record and its file are both removed: missing
Every report admin page and action is reachable only by the pinned owner, and cross-origin POSTs are refused: missing

No headless-Edge preview test, as the design says. Lesson #933 asks for a preview-frame check over https with __Host- cookies. I covered the server half only: TestPreviewHeaders runs on a TLS-configured harness with the __Host- cookie name. Whether Edge sends that cookie for the sandboxed frame is Q-006, still open and not measured here.
Report.Latest and Library.PublishedBySlug exist because the design lists them, but only tests call them. SC-005's reader pages are their callers.
Decide Q-006 by driving Edge over https with the __Host- session cookie to the sandboxed preview frame. If the cookie is not sent, the preview needs the signed-URL contract the design avoided.
The delete button has no confirmation step, because the site CSP rules out inline script and the admin page ships no script. A no-JS confirm (a checkbox or a confirm page) is worth ranking.
The e001 finish-line tests are still not in the tree (Q-009). Run them against this build once tests/acceptance exists.

deviation: Windows refuses to rename a file another handle has open (measured by the build check). A replace therefore retries setting the old file aside for up to 2 s, then refuses with ErrBusy (HTTP 409, 'Nothing changed'), leaving the old report untouched. The design named only the commit-failure branch.

deviation: The Open sweep does not blindly clear tmp/: it first restores tmp/<id>.old when the row still describes it and the file in place does not, which is critique finding m10 (a crash mid-replace must not delete the only copy). Everything else in tmp/ and any orphan reports/<n>.html is then removed, as designed.

deviation: The library lock is a sync.RWMutex. Writes hold it exclusively, and OpenRaw holds it shared while it looks the row up and opens the file, so a reader never sees the empty canonical path during a replace. The design said 'package write mutex'.
deviation: server.New now takes the opened library: New(cfg, st, lib, clock). main opens it so a data-directory failure exits 1, and harness_test.go is updated. The design left New's signature alone.

deviation: The design said TestAdminAccessMatrix needs no edits, but measurement showed the owner branch wanted 404 for every non-landing path. I replaced that with ownerRouteStatus, which quotes the observed responses (404, 405, and 400 for a bodyless POST /admin/reports); routing is unchanged. Per-row, per-method responses are asserted, not a blanket 'not 401/403/503'.
deviation: Existing store tests that assumed schema version 1 follow the embedded migration count. The injected-migration tests seed from 0001 only, so a real 0002 does not change what they prove.

deviation: Validation failures use 400 and wrong-type files use 400 rather than 415; only an oversize body is 413. Duplicate title, slug or status fields and an empty file are also refused. The design did not list these two.

drift: internal/server/templates/admin_report.html:25-27 renders only one of the two forms: Unpublish when the report is published, Publish otherwise. The design's edit page 'has publish, unpublish and delete forms'. The build did not declare this. The finish-line POSTs go straight to the action URLs, so they are unaffected.
